records.SELECT: SELECT step rank lat i 0 mstep_i, emitted after the initial k-level selection loop for each owned i
records.CONSUME: CONSUME step rank lat i n mstep_i, emitted inside the actual top-cell ice gate n<=mstep_i(i), once per owned-column substep; no per-level duplicates

source_manifest.step_source: module-level census step is assigned directly from outer kdm6_cons itimestep on each invocation; no counter or start-at-1 assumption

source_manifest.strip_check: make_g4_source.py removes every inserted guarded block and requires byte-exact normalized-source recovery.
